clans.title: Clans
clans.hint: Author up to {{count}} clans. The operator chooses how many are active (2-4) and may rename them at launch; colours and images are fixed here. Territory bar segments appear in this clan order on the dashboard.

map.title: Map & dashboard
map.positionHint: Position each territory's banner and its name/gauge cluster in the Layout editor (button in the save bar) - positions are saved per scenario.
map.framesLabel: Dashboard frames (optional - default styling is used when unset)

purge.title: The Purge
purge.hint: Once per game, a clan can punch the purge station to reset the leading clan's strongest territory to neutral. The image marks the current target on the map (position it per territory in the Layout editor) and the sound plays on every device when a purge fires.
purge.warning: Without an image, The Purge is disabled at launch in the playground (no default image is provided).
purge.stationHint: The physical balise that fires a purge, picked from your balise inventory. It is reserved: the territory balise picker greys it out, and the launch modal prefills this number. Defaults to 25.
purge.stationCollision: Balise {{station}} is already assigned to territory {{number}}. One balise cannot both validate a territory and fire a purge: remove it from the territory, or pick another balise.
purge.stationUnknown: Balise {{station}} is not in your balise inventory. Pick one from the list.
purge.pickerHint: One balise only. Those already assigned to a territory can't be selected.
purge.textsHint: Leave a field blank to keep the default wording in the launch language. %CLAN% and %TERRITORY% are substituted as in the event banner. Reword here to handle singular and plural clan names.

event_text_purge.label: Purge announcement
event_text_purge.when: Shown full-screen on every device and in the event banner when a purge succeeds (same field as in "Event banner texts").

purge_text_already_used.label: Purge already used
purge_text_already_used.placeholder: Your clan has already used its purge
purge_text_already_used.when: The bipping clan has already used its purge.

purge_text_own_territory.label: Own territory
purge_text_own_territory.placeholder: You cannot purge your own territory
purge_text_own_territory.when: The current target is a territory this clan controls.

purge_text_no_target.label: No target
purge_text_no_target.when: No clan leads yet, or the leading clan has not validated any territory.

territories.title: Territories
territories.hint: Each territory is one balise set worth pts/min (proportional to its balise count). The clan controlling the most completions holds it; a tie is neutral. Seeded with the standard 8 territories (24 balises) - edit freely.
territories.empty: No territories - reset the scenario to restore the skeleton.
territories.name: Territory name
territories.balisesHint: A chip must bip all of these stations then register at the central reader to complete the territory. Each station can belong to only one territory. Overridable per venue at launch.
territories.pickerError: Could not load the station inventory. Close and try again.
territories.pickerEmpty: No stations in your inventory. Add stations in the station manager first.

eventTexts.title: Event-banner texts
eventTexts.hint: The sentences scrolling in the bottom banner during a match. Leave a field blank to keep the app's default wording in the launch language.
eventTexts.placeholderHint: Tip: %CLAN% is replaced by the clan name (drawn in its colour) and %TERRITORY% by the territory name. With no %CLAN%, the clan name is prepended, like the default wording.

whens.event_text_conquest: A clan takes control of a territory it did not hold.
whens.event_text_attack: A clan validates a territory held by another clan without taking it yet.
whens.event_text_neutralized: A territory falls back to nobody (clans are tied).
whens.event_text_purge: A clan spends its one purge and resets a territory to neutral.
whens.ranking_title: Heading of the clan-ranking panel on the game screen.
